item.description:
JUSTINE DORSEY - Unsaid (EP)
2012 | 4 tracks | 14:47 | Carousel Rose Productions

Justine Dorsey is now known for being a part of the Y2K trip-hop band 'After' with Graham Epstein, but in the 2010s she was making her own music. This is her second release after her 2010 project Colorwheel, which was also under Carousel Rose Productions. This would be her final release under the label, before releasing her EP Under Construction in 2013 with Unison Music Group LLC.

She would then go on to release 'Best Worst Day Ever' with her sister Kerris for the movie Alexander and the Terrible, Horrible, No Good, Very Bad Day in 2014, as well as having small band projects like 'Justine and the Highs'.

As far as I know, her path with music didn't continue until meeting Graham and forming 'After'. This is a remnant of that original journey over a decade ago.

1. Unsaid - 4:27
2. Everything That's Beautiful - 3:07
3. Cliché - 4:01
4 - Mama's Song - 3:12
